title: Perjalanan Jiwa yang Diadopsi
intro: Bak watee norma-norma masyarakat berkuasa, sidroe ureung yang unik mengalami perubahan yang mendalam lam rumoh tangga yang berkat. Kisah awaknyan, nyang geutanda ngon ikatan gaséh sayang dan saboh keuputosan ilahi, geugamba keu peutheun tradisi-tradisi jameun dan geupeudong prinsip-prinsip baroe nyang ade. Narasi nyoe geutunyok peunteng jih kebenaran ateuh konvensi dan hikmah di likot peurintah Allah.
clues: Lon tom jeut keu tawanan, tapi melalui pengaturan ilahi, lon meurumpok rumoh dan keluarga baro.
Lon that geugaséh sehingga watee geubri pilihan antara keluarga kandung lon dan wali angkat lon, lon pileh untuk teutap ngon yang terakhir.
Nan lon tom na hubungan ngon wali angkat lon, saboh praktek nyang ka umum lam masyarakat lon.
Lon nakeuh sidroe-droe sahabat Nabi akhe nyang nan jih ka teugaih geuseubot le Allah lam Al-Quran.
Lon meukawen ngon sidroe inong mulia nyang sepupu Nabi, tapi pernikahan kamoe hana bertahan.
Lheuëh ulôn meucré, Allah keudroë geupeuteuntèë bahwa mantan peurumoh ulôn akan meukawén deungon Nabi, deungon lagèë njan geupeubatal saboh adat jameun teuntang adopsi.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Keputusan ilahi teuntang pernikahan dan perceraian lon .
trial.answer: Keputusan ilahi teuntang pernikahan dan perceraian lon .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Jeuet keu muezzin Islam nyang phôn .
Peugadoh praktek pra-Islam 'geukheun aneuk angkat seubagoe aneuk biologis'.
outcome.answer: Peugadoh praktek pra-Islam 'geukheun aneuk angkat seubagoe aneuk biologis'.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
